info.title: Publive Content Delivery API
info.description: Read-only API for delivering publisher content, configuration, and static assets. All endpoints require HTTP Basic Auth and are GET requests.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic Auth using your Publive API key pair, base64-encoded.

get.description: Returns site-wide publisher configuration (branding, colors, SEO defaults, social links).
Returns the site's navigation menu tree.
Returns footer configuration (app links, social links, quick menu, copyright text).
Returns ad-slot / widget slot configuration currently active on the site.
Returns the newsletter subscription groups configured for this publisher.
Returns the custom content types configured for this publisher.

Resolves an arbitrary legacy URL/slug to the content it represents (post, category, tag, author), a redirect, or not-found. Response shape varies by the resolved `data.type`.

<Info>A beta variant of this endpoint is also available at `https://cds-beta.thepublive.com/publisher/{publisher_id}/identify_url/`.</Info>

parameters.name: legacy_url
parameters.description: The path/slug to resolve. Format varies by content type: post legacy URL, category slug, `/tags/<SLUG>`, or `/author/<SLUG>`.

200.description: Content resolved, redirect, or not found — see `data.type`

status.description: HTTP status code as a string, e.g. "200", "301", "404"

content.description: Present only when type is "post": {id, title, slug, legacy_url, type, absolute_url, content_html}

get.description: Returns a paginated list of categories.
Returns full details for a single category by ID or slug.
Returns a paginated list of tags.
Returns full details for a single tag by ID or slug.
Returns a paginated list of authors.
Returns full details for a single author by ID or slug.

Returns a paginated list of posts. Supports advanced filtering via `<field>__<operator>` query params (operators: `__eq`, `__neq`, `__contains`, `__in`, `__nin`, `__gte`, `__lte`, `__gt`, `__lt`; filterable fields: `title`, `type`, `categories.id`, `tags.id`, `contributors.id`, `primary_category.id`, `created_at`, `word_count`).

<Info>Replaces the deprecated `/posts_by_category/`, `/posts_by_tag/`, `/posts_by_author/`, and `/search/` endpoints — see [Deprecated](/dxp/api-reference/deprecated/README).</Info>
Returns full details for a single post by ID or slug, including `content_json` block data not present on the listing endpoint.
Resolves a post by its relative legacy URL. Returns the same post object as [Post Details](/dxp/api-reference/content-delivery/post-details).

parameters.name: legacy_url
parameters.description: Relative URL path of the post

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of live blog updates for a post.

<Info>Only applies to posts with `type: "LiveBlog"`. For other post types, use Post Details.</Info>

Returns posts ranked by trending analytics.

<Warning>Requires the Publive analytics engine to be active on the site — returns an empty list if analytics tracking isn't implemented.</Warning>
<Info>Trending ranking refreshes every 5 minutes, plus up to another 5 minutes of CDN caching (up to 10 minutes of lag).</Info>

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filters to a single post type. Omit to include all types.

get.description: Returns a reader-facing form schema definition. Unlike other endpoints, the response has no `status`/`data` envelope — the schema object is returned directly.

parameters.name: page_source
parameters.description: Used by the serializer if applicable

example.detail: Invalid Form Schema ID format - must be a 24-character hex string

404.description: Form schema not found or not accepting submissions

example.detail: Form Schema Doesn't exist or no longer taking submissions.

get.description: Returns the publisher's ads.txt content.
Returns the publisher's robots.txt content.

Returns the publisher's push-notification service worker JS source.

<Warning>Returns 404 if push notifications aren't enabled for this publisher — check `publisher_config → widget_config_json → push_notification_config`.</Warning>

example.detail: Push notifications are not enabled for this publisher

get.description:
Returns one of the push-notification helper HTML files.

<Warning>Returns 404 if push notifications aren't enabled for this publisher.</Warning>
<Info>Resolution checks a publisher-specific S3 override first, then falls back to the shared Publive CDN default — content can differ per publisher.</Info>

example.detail: Push notifications are not enabled for this publisher

get.description: Returns the top-level sitemap index linking to the web content, news, category, and web story sitemaps.

200.description: Sitemap index XML (as JSON string content)

200.description: Sitemap index XML (as JSON string content)

200.description: News sitemap XML (as JSON string content)

get.description: Returns a standard sitemap urlset for category pages.

200.description: Category sitemap XML (as JSON string content)

get.description: Returns a sitemap index linking to paginated `webstory_sitemap_<date>.xml` entries.

200.description: Sitemap index XML (as JSON string content)

get.description: Returns one dated page of the article/web-content sitemap. Valid `date` values are discoverable from the [Web Content Sitemap](/dxp/api-reference/content-delivery/sitemap-webcontent) index.

get.description:
